mapper.select: /*selectCommonMpIvWarehousingDetailPopList*/ SELECT (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME,--[00] DECODE(H.DOC_TYPE,'S','(선입고)','') DOC_TEXT, --[01] (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.PURCHASER_DEPT) AS PO_DEPT_NAME, --[02] (SELECT C2.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C2 WHERE C2.TYPE = 'C001' AND C2.COMPANY_CODE = H.BUYER AND C2.CODE = R.REQ_DEPT) AS REQ_DEPT_NAME, --[03] H.PO_NO AS PO_NO, --[04] H.PURCHASER_NAME AS PO_USER_NAME, --[05] (SELECT L.USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR L WHERE L.COM_CODE = H.BUYER AND L.USER_ID = R.REQ_USER_ID) AS REQ_USER_NAME, --[06] H.PO_CREATE_DATE, --[07] H.AGENT_PO_TTL_AMT AS AGENT_AMT, --[08] H.PO_TTL_AMT AS PO_AMT, --[09] H.DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY, --[10] H.PO_REMARK AS REMARK, --[11] H.DOC_TYPE, --[12] H.BUYER, --[13] R.PURCHASER_DEPT, --[14] R.REQ_DEPT, --[15] H.PURCHASER_ID, --[16] R.REQ_USER_ID, --[17] DECODE(D.PROCESS_TYPE,'0','직납','1','재고','2','T/R','3','VMI') AS 납품유형, --[18] D.RD_DATE, --[19] D.PO_SEQ, --[20] (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME --[21] FROM ICOMPOHD H, ICOMPODT D, ICOMPRDT R WHERE D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND H.BUYER = D.BUYER AND H.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND D.BUYER = R.BUYER AND D.PR_NO = R.PR_NO AND D.PR_SEQ = R.PR_SEQ AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND R.STATUS <> 'D'

/*selectCommonMpIvWarehousingDetailPopList_2*/ SELECT DECODE(D.AGENT,'KR00000002', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = H.AGENT)||'-재고', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = D.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME, --[00] D.DESCRIPTION, --[01] P.MAKER_NAME, --[02] P.ITEM_QTY, --[03] P.UNIT_MEASURE, --[04] D.UNIT_PRICE, --[05] D.GR_DATE, --[06] D.BUYER_ITEM_NO, --[07] D.SPECIFICATION, --[08] D.ITEM_QTY AS GR_ITEM_QTY, --[09] NVL(D.ITEM_QTY,0) * D.UNIT_PRICE AS AGENT_SUM, --[10] D.GR_NO, D.GR_SEQ, --[11] D.AGENT --[12] FROM ICOMGRDT D, ICOMPODT P, ICOMPOHD H WHERE D.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND D.PO_NO = #{st_po_no} AND D.PO_SEQ = #{st_po_seq} AND D.BUYER = P.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = P.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = P.PO_SEQ AND P.BUYER = H.BUYER AND P.PO_NO = H.PO_NO AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY D.GR_NO, D.GR_SEQ
